source_handle: Under laughing oxygen anesthesia, local disinfection with povidone-iodine, alveolar nerve block anesthesia with lidocaine hydrochloride, and infiltration anesthesia with bistriol around the wisdom teeth. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated, the crown part of the tooth is divided by grinding with a mobile phone, the mesial obstruction is released, the pieces are loosened, and the tooth extraction forceps are taken out. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and suture to stop bleeding.
